description: Compare two authenticated JavaScript Application Graph versions supplied as full Evidence or Evidence IDs returned earlier in this session. Uses unique-only exact digest, module source digest, source-map identity, structural fingerprint, and non-module semantic-key tiers. Reports added, removed, changed, ambiguous, and unknown entities plus a bounded changed_from graph without fuzzy or module-ordinal pairing.
